# FLX-3671: a Simulation declares response families and pins no profile to read them from

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A response family is estimated from the cells of the profile the Simulation pins, so a Simulation that declares responses pins that profile under extensions['com.agentics.flux/1'].profile and passes it to plan with --profile. Nothing else is read for an estimate.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3671
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
